QF.id: IV Strategies Using Interest Rate Derivatives_65

question.text: What is the regulatory position on algorithmic trading strategies in the ETIRD market?

answer.text: Algorithmic trading is permitted subject to prior stock exchange permission and SEBI/stock exchange algo trading guidelines including risk controls and periodic system audits
Algorithmic trading is banned in all interest rate derivative markets
Algorithmic trading requires no special approval and is freely available to all
Only high-frequency trading firms approved by RBI can use algorithms

explanation.text: The Logic: Per NISM Series IV (p.199), algorithmic trading is permitted subject to prior permission of the stock exchange and compliance with SEBI/stock exchange algo trading guidelines, which include risk control requirements and six-monthly system audits. The Trap: The framework does not require "SEBI approval" — it requires prior stock exchange permission. Algo trading is neither banned nor freely available without controls, and RBI is not the approving authority for exchange-traded algo trading. Note: Algo brokers may face higher BMC/additional deposit and must demonstrate adequate risk controls on an ongoing basis.
